title: Metals Trader
full_description:
London, United Kingdom
Department Overview:The Commodity Trading desk is providing commodity hedges and risk management solutions. The main clients are corporates with hedging needs in the commodity space. The desk has a global presence with teams in New York, Singapore and London. The desk covers a wide product range, covering Energy, Base and Precious Metals and Softs & Agri's.
Qualification/Education
Educated to Degree level, within finance, economics, maths, science or related subject
Previous work experience in banking, trading or risk management roles.
Candidates with back or middle office commodities experience and a desire to move into trading can also be considered
Excellent Excel and numeracy skills
Programming skills and ability to develop desk tools using VBA and Python is critical.
Personal Competencies
Strong numeracy and analytical skills
Proactive behaviour and perpetual energy and drive to improve performance.
Detail-oriented with the ability to make quick and accurate decisions in a fast-paced environment.
Effective team player with good interpersonal and communication skills
Challenger of the status quo, always striving to do things more efficiently and effectively
Main Duties and Responsibilities of Role:
Actively follow developments in (paper) commodity markets
Continuously check and update relevant market parameters
Price indicative and firm quotes for clients
Actively contribute to IT developments for the desk
Support senior traders in their daily routine
Support portfolio owners manage the risk positions of the desk within the applicable limits and desk risk tolerance.
100% observance of all FCA requirements, industry conduct rules and ING Compliance standards.
Produce daily PnL and research reports
Increasing scope and responsibility in a growing trading book
Possibility for STA or permanent assignment in other FM Trading locations
